summary: Distinct CC BY 4.0 single-leaf door with original frame, paired handles, hinge barrels and strike plate. Reviewed fitting and collider preparation pass static, viewed previews and isolated RTX 4090 physics.

component_review.5: Original moving leaf; full collider retained.
component_review.1_2_3_4: Both handles and plates remain moving and collidable.
component_review.6_7_8: Original moving hinge barrels/cap remain collidable; 6 and 8 center the measured axis.
component_review.0: Moving lock-edge plate remains collidable; no separate latch bolt identified.
component_review.9_10: Original fixed U-frame and strike-side plate retain collision.

modifications: Uniform 0.70 scale and proper rotation into the common Z-up, floor-centered closed pose; no reflected mesh or source animation control.
Uniform 2% moving leaf/handle fit and 18 mm outward normal shift resolve reviewed rebate and hinge/frame intersections; the source and all collidable parts remain.
Partition the existing rebated frame collider along measured opening surfaces while retaining its original visual mesh.
Use one convex leaf collider to cover the outer door skin omitted by default cooking; its envelope fills decorative glazed recesses for contact.
Use the centers of two original hinge barrels for an ideal revolute axis instead of their outermost edges.
limits: The 2% fit, 18 mm offset, ideal revolute axis and convex leaf envelope are explicit simulation approximations; they are not original engineering dimensions or functioning latch mechanics.
The source animation is not the push control path. Robot/expert qualification remains for Subphase 5.1.
